jobs.title: Chargé.e de campagne marketing client et produits
jobs.description: La Fédération des Entreprises Romandes Genève est l'organisation patronale incontournable du canton. Forte de 29'000 entreprises membres et de plus de 80 associations professionnelles, elle joue un rôle central dans la vie économique et sociale de la région. Ses équipes accompagnent chaque jour les employeurs sur des sujets aussi variés que le droit du travail, la sécurité sociale, la formation professionnelle, la santé au travail ou encore la négociation collective. Un périmètre large, des métiers diversifiés, une mission qui a du sens. Rejoindre la FER Genève, c'est intégrer une institution de référence et contribuer chaque jour à faire vivre l'économie genevoise. Description du poste Vous aimez transformer une bonne idée en campagne qui produit des résultats ? La FER Genève recherche un·e chargé/e de campagnes marketing client et produits . La FER Genève accompagne les entreprises et les associations professionnelles du canton à travers une large gamme de services. Pour soutenir le rayonnement de l’institution, mieux faire connaître ses prestations et renforcer leur utilisation, nous recherchons une personne capable de comprendre les besoins des équipes métiers, de concevoir des campagnes pertinentes et d’en suivre concrètement la performance. Votre rôle : Vous êtes le point de rencontre entre les équipes qui portent nos services et les publics auxquels nous voulons nous adresser. Vous transformez les demandes de promotion en campagnes structurées : objectifs, audiences, proposition de valeur, messages, canaux, calendrier, budget et mesure des résultats. Vous pilotez les campagnes de bout en bout, tout en travaillant avec les spécialistes de la communication, du graphisme, du web, de l’expérience digitale et des réseaux sociaux. Vous contribuez aussi directement à la production de contenus et à l’activation de nos canaux. Vos principales responsabilités : Comprendre et cadrer les besoins de communication clients et promotion des équipes métiers. Conseiller vos interlocuteurs sur les audiences, les messages et les leviers marketing. Construire des plans de campagne multicanaux, avec des objectifs et des indicateurs clairs. Produire directement ou, lorsque nécessaire, rédiger les briefs pour des prestataires internes ou externes et coordonner la production des contenus et supports. Déployer des campagnes sur les canaux owned et paid, avec les spécialistes internes et les prestataires. Suivre les résultats, analyser les écarts et recommander des optimisations. Organiser le retour d’expérience afin d’améliorer continuellement les campagnes. Profil recherché Votre profil : Formation supérieure en marketing, marketing digital, communication ou domaine équivalent. Expérience confirmée dans la conception et le pilotage de campagnes, idéalement dans un environnement B2B, B2B2C ou de services. Capacité à passer du besoin métier à une stratégie et à un plan d’actions opérationnel. Bonne compréhension des canaux digitaux, des contenus et de la mesure de performance. Plume claire, esprit d’analyse et sens de l’organisation. Autonomie, curiosité, pragmatisme et goût du travail transversal. Français courant ; anglais professionnel apprécié.   Ce que nous vous offrons : Un poste transversal avec un impact direct sur la visibilité et le développement de la FER Genève. Vous pourrez faire évoluer les pratiques de campagne et collaborer avec des équipes métiers et des spécialistes complémentaires.

jobs.title: Watchmaker Operator / Watchmaker / Watch Services Specialist 100% (m/f/d) - Geneva
jobs.description: Discover Bucherer Worldwide, Bucherer embodies excellence in the world of exceptional watches and refined jewellery. Thanks to a unique combination of tradition, innovation and artisanal expertise, the House has established itself as an essential reference in the market. Present in more than 100 boutiques around the world, we welcome a discerning clientele every day. With passion and impeccable hospitality, we offer much more than products: a true experience. More than 2,000 committed employees share the same ambition: to convey their fascination for exceptional pieces and to make every encounter with our clients a privileged moment. Your role within our house: You welcome and advise our demanding Swiss and international clientele within our After-Sales Service (ASS). You ensure an exemplary image of Bucherer through the excellence of your work and service. You take charge of first-level watch maintenance activities. You perform simple adjustments on watches and battery replacements, resizing of straps. You ensure the administrative follow-up of ASS files, respecting quality standards in terms of file completion and information in accordance with our procedures. You handle logistics, shipping, tracking and receipt of watches. You are responsible for ordering and receiving supplies. You ensure impeccable information flow between colleagues and actively support them. Your profile: You hold at least a Federal Professional Certificate (AFP) as a watchmaking operator or a Watchmaker (CFC). Ideally, you have several years of experience within an After-Sales Service (ASS). You stand out for your professional rigour and attention to detail that makes a difference for our clientele. You have a keen sense of service and exemplary customer orientation. As a native French speaker, you have excellent command of English; German is an asset. You are comfortable with managing computer systems. You possess a strong sense of responsibility, excellent team spirit and flexibility. Your appearance is neat and professional. Why join Bucherer? Because for us, it is much more than a job: it is passion that makes the difference. Our employees share a commitment to artisanal excellence, impeccable service and a true team spirit. We combine the heritage of Swiss tradition with an international openness, in a working environment where quality, collaboration and high standards are at the heart of everything we do. At Bucherer, we encourage individual development, cultivate innovation and offer everyone the opportunity to reveal their potential, together, within a team that inspires and unites. At Bucherer, you particularly benefit from the following advantages: 40-hour work week At least 27 days of holiday per year Flexible working models, with the possibility of remote work when the role allows Preferential purchase conditions on watches and jewellery Particularly advantageous benefits on the occasion of the birth of a child Attractive coverage in terms of pension fund and social insurances We look forward to receiving your application. Your Human Resources team Bucherer AG

jobs.title: Chef.fe de projet sanitaire
jobs.description: Afin de renforcer notre équipe sanitaire à Genève, nous sommes à la recherche d'un.e chef.fe de projet sanitaire à 100%. Chef.fe de projet sanitaire Vos responsabilités Planifier, coordonner et superviser la réalisation des installations sanitaires; Etablir les offres techniques et commerciales ainsi que les soumissions; Assurer le suivi technique, financier et administratif des projets; Gérer les plannings de réalisation et contrôler l'avancement des travaux; Être l'interlocuteur principal des clients, partenaires et sous-traitants; Garantir les respect des normes en vigueur et les exigences de qualité et de sécurité. Ce qui vous caractérise Formation souhaitée dans le sanitaire; Expérience confirmée dans la gestion de projets sanitaires en Suisse; Excellente maîtrise de la gestion financière et suivi budgétaire des projets; Bonnes compétences en négociation et service client; Sens de l'organisation, autonomie et esprit d'initiative. Voici ce que nous offrons Possibilités de formations continues; Conditions d'emploi attractives au sein d'un groupe reconnu; Bonnes prestations sociales. Equans En tant que premier prestataire de solutions globales pour le bâtiment et l'énergie en Suisse, nous soutenons la transformation et la numérisation de nos clients et travaillons ensemble à la transition énergétique. Nos prestations couvrent l'ensemble du cycle de vie des bâtiments, sites, infrastructures et quartiers. En tant que leader du marché, nos clients bénéficient d'une gamme complète de services auprès d'un seul interlocuteur ainsi que de solutions à leurs projets élaborées de façon intégrée et en équipe. Nous disposons d'une présence dans toute la Suisse et employons 6500 personnes réparties sur 140 sites. Cela nous permet de mettre en œuvre efficacement des projets aussi bien régionaux que couvrant tout le pays. Outre la technique et l'automation des bâtiments ainsi que le Facility Management, notre offre comprend également des spécialisations telles que l'approvisionnement en énergie, les transports, les télécommunications, la numérisation et l'optimisation énergétique. Nous concevons, construisons et réalisons ainsi des projets qui s'étendent de bâtiments intelligents à des centrales électriques d'avenir en passant par des tunnels. Lieu de travail Equans Switzerland Route de la Galaise 15b 1228 Plan-les-Ouates Ta personne de contact Laura Bianchi

jobs.description: "Swiss handball strengthens the cohesion of a modern, constantly changing society" To further develop our own events from international matches and cup finals to partner and community occasions, we are immediately or by arrangement seeking a creative, entrepreneurial and implementation-strong personality as: Head of Events & Experiences 80-100% Your area of responsibility Event development & fan experience: You consistently develop our event formats and the entire fan journey. With coherent dramaturgy, entertainment and surprising moments, you make international matches, cup finals and other SHV events special experiences before, during and after the event. Innovation & technology: You combine live experiences with digital possibilities, data and new technologies and transfer relevant impulses from other areas & industries. Event, hospitality and activation offerings: Together with marketing & sponsorship, you identify new commercial potentials and develop activatable event and hospitality offers with added value for fans, partners and the association. Planning & control: You are responsible for concepts, schedules, budgets, service providers and partners and ensure quality, cost-effectiveness and reliable implementation. Operational event implementation: You manage the preparation and on-site execution, keep an overview even in dynamic situations and pitch in where needed. Team leadership & collaboration: You lead a small event team as a player-coach and work closely with marketing & sponsorship, communication & marketing, sport and external partners. In this position, you not only shape individual events but also influence how people experience Swiss handball. You combine creative ideas with entrepreneurial thinking and operational excellence with the aim of creating enthusiasm and sustainable economic success equally. Your profile Several years of experience in the conception and implementation of complex events or live experiences – for example in sport, entertainment, festivals, brand experience or hospitality Strong sense for target groups, dramaturgy, entertainment and the details that make an event a genuine and successful experience Ability to think impact, quality and cost-effectiveness together as well as to recognise and consistently develop potentials Structured, independent and solution-oriented working style with high reliability, resilience and enjoyment of operational responsibility Openness to new technologies, data and impulses from other industries as well as courage to constructively question the status quo and try new things Inspiring, team-oriented personality who provides guidance, takes responsibility and effectively brings together different internal and external stakeholders You do not just want to manage existing processes but rethink events and implement them excellently at the same time. You do not only ask: "How have we done it so far?" but also: "How good could it become?" In doing so, you keep the needs of the fans as well as those of our teams, partners and other stakeholders in mind. Our offer We promote an open, team-oriented culture where innovation, ownership and flexibility are highly valued. You will have plenty of scope for design, short decision-making paths and the opportunity to visibly further develop the event world of Swiss handball. If you want to create live experiences that people will still talk about the next day, you will score a direct hit with us! From winter 2026, we will move: From Olten to Cham into new offices right next to the OYM College, see www.oym-college.ch . Further information about the Swiss Handball Association can be found at www.handball.ch .

Ensuring compliance with work instructions, procedures and guidelines Preparation of safety concepts in collaboration with safety officers Specification and monitoring of special testing, acceptance and documentation requirements Review of technical plans, specifications and project documents Analysis and resolution of technical challenges during project execution Support in technical decision-making processes Your Competencies Experience in project execution in industrial plant construction or related fields. Process engineering knowledge about the function and handling of technical plants and piping systems. Ability to read and understand piping diagrams. Knowledge of occupational safety and environmental protection, especially in handling chemicals IT skills: confident use of PC, tablet and smartphone; very good knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, Project) as well as experience with digital tools and software packages (DME) and web-based applications. Knowledge of the most important materials in plant construction. Knowledge of pipe classes and related standards Knowledge of working methods and documentation in the GMP environment. Sense of responsibility, diligence and high quality standards Leadership and motivational skills, willingness to delegate, dynamism and commitment Organisational skills, structured working method, time and project management abilities Communication skills, assertiveness and negotiation skills Teamwork, willingness to cooperate and ability to collaborate with various stakeholders Resilience, flexibility, agility in adjustments as well as competence in conflict and crisis management Reflective ability as well as high social competence Economic and entrepreneurial thinking and acting, combined with a solution-oriented working method, high quality awareness as well as process- and risk-oriented action Values of the Passivation Department – cleanliness, safety and cooperation – not only known but actively lived and embodied in daily work. Honest and transparent conduct towards customers, colleagues and co-workers. Communication within the team, with superiors and clients. Consistency between words and actions, especially in leadership and communication situations. Coordination of the project team and personnel resource planning. Leadership and motivation of the project team, conducting project meetings and preparing progress reports. Good understanding and written expression skills in German and English. French language skills are an advantage. Driving licence category B. Do you want to take responsibility and build something together with a motivated team? If you want to be part of this success story, we look forward to receiving your application.
